items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Then we would come in, from Kansas City, those Douglas Brothers.

ctx.x: And of course, who would always be, as the years went on, right at the beginning, you had Earl Bostic and Luther West and they were all there and if anybody could compete with them, they were pretty darn good.
Earl, as far as a soloist, he was just tops.
